deployments_detail.use: Seismic foundation models pre-trained on global seismic datasets for subsurface interpretation
TGS Imaging AnyWare AI/ML-driven seismic imaging on AWS cloud

Seismic Foundation Model (SFM) — a Vision Transformer (ViT) with Masked AutoEncoder (MAE) training that analyzes 3D seismic data to identify geological structures for energy exploration. Distributed training on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod using EC2 P5 instances (16 nodes, 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs each), S3 streaming, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, ring attention/context parallelism. [AWS (SageMaker HyperPod, EC2 P5), NVIDIA H200 GPUs, DeepSpeed]
deployments_detail.value: Training time cut from 6 months to 5 days; ~90-95% parallel efficiency; 4.5x larger context window; 64-80 GBps cluster throughput; 1,974 samples/sec

deployments_detail.use: TGS Imaging AnyWare — cloud-native seismic processing and imaging platform migrated to AWS by EPAM, delivering AI-ready/AI-enabled subsurface workflows (Data Verse subsurface data-as-a-service, composable AI workflows via EPAM Energy HPC Orchestrator) on AWS Graviton and Spot instances. [AWS, EPAM Systems]

SaltNet — 3D machine learning model (CNN-based image classification) for automated salt body interpretation on seismic data, offered as a commercial product to expedite exploration; integrates with MDIO data format. [TGS (in-house CNN/deep learning)]

Earth Science Analytics EarthNET collaboration — cloud-native AI application installed in TGS's cloud environment to produce derivative seismic products (porosity, lithology, water saturation, fault mapping, geobody extraction) via AI geological interpretation. [Earth Science Analytics (EarthNET)]
deployments_detail.value: Applied to Utsira OBN survey covering over 1,500 sq km

deployments_detail.use: End-to-end ML workflow for well-log prediction at basin scale — automated data-cleaning pipeline plus ML models that predict missing wireline log curves; results delivered to clients through TGS's R360 eCommerce platform. [TGS (in-house ML)]
deployments_detail.value: 90-95% prediction quality in blind test of 679 wells (Permian Basin)

deployments_detail.use: Well Log Foundation Model — a 60M-parameter well-log Vision Transformer (ViT-MAE) foundation model pre-trained on 1.1M North American well logs for log imputation and fine-tuned on 271,972 human-interpreted formation tops from 44,062 Permian Basin wells for promptable formation-depth interpretation. [TGS (in-house ViT-MAE)]
deployments_detail.value: 60M parameters; trained on 1.1M well logs and 271,972 formation tops across 44,062 wells

deployments_detail.use: Agentic AI for subsurface intelligence — multi-agent framework (with AWS GenAI Innovation Center) that converts SEG-Y archives to MDIO, reconstructs seismic metadata from legacy headers via agents, and uses embedding-based vector/graph retrieval for natural-language search across acquisition/processing reports. [AWS GenAI Innovation Center]

Quantico Energy Solutions collaboration — combining TGS seismic data and Analytics Ready LAS (ARLAS, ML-predicted well-log curves) with Quantico's QRes, a physics-plus-ML solution producing high-resolution earth-model properties (porosity, water saturation, compressive strength) from seismic. [Quantico Energy Solutions (QRes)]
deployments_detail.value: ARLAS predicts missing well-log curves in high 90% accuracy range

deployments_detail.use: Automation of the time-processing sequence — ML/deep-learning models embedded in TGS's Imaging AnyWare software that deploy global ML models from a centralized repository into imaging workflows for consistent, higher-quality seismic pre-processing without per-project retraining. [TGS (in-house deep learning)]
